title: Beatrix and the Songbook
author: Wendell Okafor
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
